notes.title: Update for French language support!
notes.content:
We received an offer from wapiaclm to translate D10RAMA's work on this title, "Absent in the Rain"!

This was an unexpected pleasure for us, and we decided to take this opportunity to make this update so that users in French-speaking countries can enjoy "Absent in the Rain" as well.

We are deeply grateful to wapiaclm for their steady translation work.



You can switch languages from the title screen.

We hope that many more people will enjoy this update!

notes.title: Update for Russian language support!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43018098/23d0d57383853ea20b3b926f6e796406691bb7d3.png

We received an offer from VNka to fan-translate D10RAMA's work on this title, "Ame ni shite Hito wo hazure"!
This was an unexpected pleasure for us, and we decided to take this opportunity to make this update so that users in Russian-speaking countries can enjoy "Ame ni shite Hito wo hazure" as well.
We are deeply grateful to VNka and Quest Lion for their steady translation work.
The Russian title is named "Пропавшие под дождём" as they suggested!

You can switch languages from the title screen.
We hope that many more people will enjoy this update!

---

Мы получили предложение на фанатский перевод работы D10RAMA "Ame ni shite Hito wo hazure" от VNka!
Это было для нас неожиданной радостью, и мы решили использовать эту возможность для создания этого полноценного обновления, чтобы "Ame ni shite Hito wo hazure" смогли насладиться читатели из русскоязычных стран.
Мы очень благодарны VNka и QuestLion за их усердную работу над переводом.
Русское название - "Пропавшие под дождём", как они и предложили!

Вы можете поменять язык в главном меню.
Мы надеемся, что это обновление обрадует большое количество людей!

notes.title: "Absent in the Rain" is now Spanish!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43018098/c6e610aae2d0508fe1e49edd7eec68cb2fcb46de.png
Spanish update of "Absent in the Rain" is now available!

While we were working on the English update of "Ame ni shite hito hitori", Shinzou translations offered us the opportunity to fan-translate D10RAMA's work.
This was an unexpected pleasure for us, and we decided to take this opportunity to make this update so that Spanish-speaking users can enjoy "Absent in the Rain" as well.
We would like to thank Shinzou translations for their prompt translation work.
The title of this update is "Perdidos en la Lluvia" as suggested by Shinzou translations.

You can switch languages from the title screen.
We hope that more people will enjoy this update!

---

¡Hemos actualizado "Absent in the Rain" para agregar una versión en español!

Mientras trabajábamos en la traducción al inglés de "Absent in the rain", Shinzou translations nos ofreció hacer una traducción de nuestro juego.
Fue una inesperada sorpresa y decidimos aprovechar la oportunidad para que los usuarios hispanohablantes pudieran disfrutar de "Absent in the Rain".
Queremos dar las gracias a Shinzou translations por su rapidez a la hora de realizar la traducción.
El título que escogimos surgió de la sugerencia de Shinzou translations: "Perdidos en la Lluvia".

Pueden cambiar el idioma desde el menú principal.
¡Esperamos que con esta actualización más personas disfruten de nuestra historia!
